concept: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits
summary: 12 source-anchored research claims on LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits, grouped by facet. Original confidence and source-owner limits are retained.

facts.text: Database-backed virtual keys require PostgreSQL and a configured proxy master key. The global max_budget setting does not enforce a spend cap when no database is connected.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

facts.text: LiteLLM TPM counting defaults to input plus output and can select input or output globally. Admission reserves estimated tokens before reconciling real usage; missing output bounds can therefore cause over-admission or unexpected rejection.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

facts.text: Budget reservation is enabled unless disable_budget_reservation is true. It estimates request cost before dispatch and settles reservations against calculated response cost; disabling it permits concurrent requests to exceed a recorded-spend ceiling.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

facts.text: default_key_generate_params fills missing or null fields. Its budget_duration exception lets an explicit null skip that configured default and create a budget that never resets, unless upperbound_key_generate_params applies. Upperbounds also supply defaults, including budget_duration when missing or null, and reject excessive values rather than silently clamping them.
facts.note: confidence low; single-owner LiteLLM evidence; qualify exact deployment · confidence: low

facts.text: A key duration controls credential expiry; budget_duration controls spend-window resets. Do not use a budget reset interval as a substitute for expiring or revoking a credential.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

facts.text: The current budget guide marks virtual-key model_max_budget as an Enterprise-licensed feature. Check the installed license and release before relying on per-model dollar budgets.
facts.note: confidence low; single-owner LiteLLM evidence; qualify exact deployment · confidence: low

facts.text: Classify 429 responses before retrying. Transient provider rate limits can carry retry-after, while exhausted spend access persists until the budget or account state changes; repeatedly resending requests cannot repair a spend cap.
facts.note: confidence medium; native contracts do not independently certify LiteLLM implementation · confidence: medium

facts.text: When budget reservations or rate counters cannot be verified, the opt-in fail_closed_budget_enforcement and fail_closed_rate_limit_enforcement paths can reject with HTTP 503. Treat this as an availability tradeoff and test the exact entity and route.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

facts.text: LiteLLM prices spend from its model cost information. The spend guide warns that missing rates can produce usage-bearing zero-dollar records; reconcile pricing and provider billing instead of assuming zero tracked spend means free inference.
facts.note: confidence low; single-owner LiteLLM evidence; qualify exact deployment · confidence: low

facts.text: Batch submission contains input_file_id, not all prompts. The budget guide says its submission reservation cannot price the complete batch, releases that reservation, and records final cost later; batch throughput needs separate controls.
facts.note: confidence low; single-owner LiteLLM evidence; qualify exact deployment · confidence: low

facts.text: Provider token accounting differs: OpenAI documents an admission estimate involving max_tokens and request size; Claude OTPM counts actual generated output and ignores max_tokens. A gateway reservation does not replace either upstream limit.
facts.note: confidence medium; native contracts do not independently certify LiteLLM implementation · confidence: medium

facts.text: At commit 82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96, personal user-budget checks skip team keys unless apply_user_budget_to_team_keys is true. This is commit-specific evidence, not proof of a deployed release default.
facts.note: confidence medium; single-owner LiteLLM evidence · confidence: medium

evidenceQualification.scope: Documentation and pinned-code research; native provider sources do not certify the gateway implementation.
